description: Potentiel solaire de production de chaleur sous vide (usages spéciaux) is a dataset listed in Swiss national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Kanton Genf. La couche du potentiel de production de chaleur sous vide (usages spéciaux) par surface de base (pan de toiture, couvert, parking) représente et regroupe les informations relatives au potentiel de production d'énergie thermique: - tenant compte des surfaces bien exposées (qui ont une irradiation solaire brute annuelle dépassant 1000 [kWh/m2 an], nommées ci-après surfaces utiles). Coverage: Kanton Genf. The portal files it under the publisher Kanton Genf. It offers 7 resource(s) in API, CSV, SHP, WFS, WMS. The portal shows 2026-09-15 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is opendata.swiss terms of use: open use. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ch-portal.
